fields.title: Kerala Monsoon Flood Relief 2024
fields.description: Emergency relief fund for families affected by severe flooding in Wayanad and Idukki districts. Funds will be used for temporary shelter, food supplies, and rebuilding assistance.

fields.title: Monthly Food Supply for Orphanage Children
fields.description: Help us provide nutritious meals for 150 children at Trivandrum Children's Orphanage. Your donation covers rice, vegetables, fruits, and protein sources for one month.

fields.title: Winter Clothes Distribution Drive
fields.description: Collect and distribute warm clothing for homeless individuals in Thiruvananthapuram during the winter season. Target: 500 people.

fields.title: Emergency Medical Supplies for Kochi
fields.description: Urgent need for medical supplies including antibiotics, antiseptics, bandages, and basic medicines for the medical camp in Kochi serving 2000+ patients monthly.

fields.title: Hygiene Kits for Flood Victims
fields.description: Provide essential hygiene kits containing soap, toothpaste, sanitary products, and towels for 1000 families displaced by recent floods in Alappuzha.

fields.title: Educational Materials for Orphanage
fields.description: Support education for orphanage children with books, stationery, school uniforms, and computer equipment. Help 150 children continue their studies.
